check_events.outcome: Checked the definition-level claim conditional on 1→π_K→E_K→Γ→1 and source extension 1→1→Γ→Γ→1 over fixed Γ. A map of these extensions is precisely a homomorphism s:Γ→E_K whose composition with the projection is id_Γ, hence a section; conversely every section defines the extension map. The kernel map is always the unique 1→π_K and does not encode the section. The same argument holds in the continuous category when continuity is required. Neither existence of sections nor the reconstruction theorem is asserted.
